verdict.rationale: Framer documents a Server API that lets a programmatic consumer automate publishing and bring Framer into other products, which is genuine headless automation, but the evidence covers only that thin mention. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI integration guide, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), details of the automatable operations beyond publishing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Connect your product and automate publishing with the Framer API.
Use the Server API to bring Framer into your product
